journey.label: Technical / RFP only
journey.title: API_Journey_RFP_only_1790536735470

steps.title: Sign in as the buyer
steps.expected: The app accepts the buyer's existing web-console session for PROCOL DEMO (read from the database, so no one-time code is sent) and answers with the dashboard configuration.
steps.actual: Using Procol Support's web-console session for PROCOL DEMO — the app accepted it (role: super_admin).

steps.title: Create the draft event
steps.expected: A draft event is created for PROCOL DEMO with one line item (41 KG of the catalog product) and comes back with its id.
steps.actual: Draft ZFpwY3Bj was created with one line item (41 KG).

steps.title: Add the technical round (RFP)
steps.expected: The technical round (RFP) is attached to the draft as round 1 of 1, assigned to md.tahir@m3mindia.com to score, with bidding open 00:48–00:49.
steps.actual: Round 1 (technical round, RFP) was attached as ZGNEa05n, with md.tahir@m3mindia.com as its evaluator; bidding open 00:48–00:49.

steps.title: Publish the event to the invited vendor
steps.expected: “API_Journey_RFP_only_1790536735470” goes live — status active — with 1 round attached and the invited vendor able to see it.
steps.actual: “API_Journey_RFP_only_1790536735470” is now active with 1 round, visible to 1 vendor.

steps.title: Read the event back
steps.expected: Reading the event back shows it active with 1 round and the invited vendor on it.
steps.actual: The event reads back as active with 1 round.

steps.title: Sign in as the vendor
steps.postman: auth › vendor_generate otp, vendor verify otp
steps.expected: A one-time code is sent to amd@gmail.com and, once verified, signs the vendor into the supplier app.
steps.actual: Signed in as the vendor (AMD LTD, amd@gmail.com) — the one-time code was accepted. This user's home company is WE5EWlpa; the bid is placed for the invited WE5aWlpa.

steps.title: Open the technical round as the vendor
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › get technical trade details
steps.expected: The vendor can open the technical round and sees its forms, including the line-item form to answer.
steps.actual: The vendor sees 2 forms on the technical round; the line-item form is WlFETnBY with 1 page.

steps.title: Start the technical response
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › start technical response
steps.expected: A technical response is opened for AMD LTD on the technical round and comes back with its id.
steps.actual: A technical response Y3BYY1g= was opened for AMD LTD.

steps.title: Answer the technical form
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › Fill Technical Answers
steps.expected: The line-item form is answered (Specs: “auto spec answer”) and the app accepts the answers.
steps.actual: The line-item form was answered (Specs: “auto spec answer”).

steps.title: Submit the technical response
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › submit technical response
steps.expected: The technical response is submitted and the app accepts it.
steps.actual: The technical response was submitted (status active).

steps.title: Wait for the bidding window to close
steps.expected: The bidding window closes at 00:49:45; the run waits for it (plus 8 seconds) before evaluating or awarding.

steps.title: Sign in as the evaluator
steps.postman: auth › evaluator generate otp, evaluator verify otp
steps.expected: A one-time code is sent to md.tahir@m3mindia.com's phone and, once verified, signs the evaluator into the web console.
steps.actual: Signed in as the evaluator (md.tahir@m3mindia.com) — the one-time code was accepted.

steps.title: Open the technical responses to score
steps.expected: The evaluator can open the technical round's forms and one of them is assigned to md.tahir@m3mindia.com to score.
steps.actual: The evaluator sees 2 forms; the one assigned to md.tahir@m3mindia.com is WlFaTnBY. Bidding closed at 00:49:49.

steps.title: Score the vendor's technical response
steps.expected: A score out of 10 is recorded on md.tahir@m3mindia.com's form for AMD LTD's response and the app answers success: true.
steps.actual: The app refused it: HTTP 422 — “Insufficient parameters” (code 2).

steps.title: Submit the evaluation
steps.expected: The evaluation is submitted for the technical round and the app accepts it.
steps.actual: Did not run — no score was recorded to submit (step 14 — Score the vendor's technical response — was refused).
steps.reason: no score was recorded to submit (step 14 — Score the vendor's technical response — was refused)

journey.outcome: 13 of 14 steps worked; step 14 — score the vendor's technical response — was refused: “Insufficient parameters”. 1 step that depended on it did not run.

setupSteps.did: Draft ZFpwY3Bj was created with one line item (41 KG).
Round 1 (technical round, RFP) was attached as ZGNEa05n, with md.tahir@m3mindia.com as its evaluator; bidding open 00:48–00:49.
“API_Journey_RFP_only_1790536735470” is now active with 1 round, visible to 1 vendor.
The event reads back as active with 1 round.
